subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a Google product?
solution:
The correct option is__** iTunes.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** iTunes Store** is a digital media store operated by** Apple Inc.** 
 
• It opened on **April 28, 2003**, as a result of **Steve Jobs**.
 
• **Tim Cook** is the CEO of Apple Inc. since** 2011**.
 
• **Google** was founded on **September 4, 1998**, by **Larry Page** and **Sergey Brin**.
 
• **Sundar Pichai **was appointed CEO of Google on** October 24, 2015**, replacing **Larry Page**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **December 3, 2019**, **Pichai** also became the CEO of** Alphabet.**
 
• **YouTube**
 
 
• YouTube is an American online video-sharing and social media platform.
 
• Its headquarter is in **San Bruno, California**.
 
• It was launched on **February 14, 2005**, by **Steve Chen, Chad Hurley, and Jawed Karim**.
 
 
 
• **Blogger**
 
 
• Blogger is an American online content management system.
 
• It was developed by** Pyra Labs** and its founders are **Evan Williams, Meg Hourihan**.
 
• It was acquired by Google in** 2003**.
 
 
 
• **Gmail**
 
 
• Gmail is a free email service provided by Google.
 
• It was launched by Google in **2004.**
